# PSantos Construction

> Independent hardscaping and stone masonry contractor in Milford, Massachusetts. Retaining walls, paver patios, stone walls, stone veneer, block walls, outdoor kitchens, fire places, fire pits and snow plowing across MetroWest and Greater Boston. 8+ years in business, fixed-price quotes, licensed and insured.

- Service area: Milford, Hopkinton, Wellesley, Newton and surrounding MetroWest, MA towns
